description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by disc-0003, which pins the RFC 9264-conformant link set. The case this file originally proved — the shape of the single discovery file and its relation-name closure — is preserved in disc-0003; the shape itself was abolished by D55. A withdrawn vector is never run for or against a conformance claim (AGSC-09-05).
reason: Withdrawn at 1.0.0-rc.2 by D55 (V4-A A-08). This vector pinned the pre-D55 discovery document: top_level_members ["integrity","linkset"], the fixed integrity member names (bundle, counts, generated_at, hashes, ledger_head, spec_version) and the vendor media type application/vnd.agenticsystemcore.agentic-knowledge+json. RFC 9264 4.2.1 requires linkset to be the sole top-level member and no vendor media type is defined or registered any more. Superseded by disc-0003.
